instruction:
Create `/home/user/Desktop/lm324.lbr`, an EAGLE library for an LM324 quad op-amp, and save it.

Requirements:
1. The file must parse as XML.
2. It must contain exactly one `<package>` whose name contains `DIP` and `14`, with 14 through-hole `<pad>` elements named `1` through `14`.
3. It must contain exactly one `<symbol>` whose pin names are `IN+`, `IN-`, `OUT`, `V+`, and `V-`.
4. It must contain exactly one `<deviceset>` with `prefix="U"` and four `<gate>` entries named `A`, `B`, `C`, and `D`, all referencing the same symbol.
5. Every gate must have `swaplevel="1"`.
6. The device `<connects>` mapping must be:
A: `OUT->1`, `IN-->2`, `IN+->3`, `V+->4`, `V-->11`
B: `IN+->5`, `IN-->6`, `OUT->7`, `V+->4`, `V-->11`
C: `OUT->8`, `IN-->9`, `IN+->10`, `V+->4`, `V-->11`
D: `IN+->12`, `IN-->13`, `OUT->14`, `V+->4`, `V-->11`
7. Pads `4` and `11` must appear in the connects for every gate.
